newsitem.title: GERMANY: Kohl says govt expects big success with D.Telekom.
newsitem.headline: Kohl says govt expects big success with D.Telekom.

text.p: German Chancellor Helmut Kohl said on Friday that the government would take care to make sure the proposed sale of further Deutsche Telekom shares does not harm the company or small shareholders.
"It is not in our interests that this is a failure -- on the contrary we want it to be a giant success," Kohl said in a speech to the lower house of parliament.

"The first bourse flotation was excellent," Kohl said. "It is reasonable to sell more shares. But only the conditions that keep an eye on and protects the shareholders interests. It will be privatised step by step."
Finance Minister Theo Waigel said on Thursday the government was considering reducing its 75 percent stake in Telekom earlier than originally planned in the year 2000.
